question: What fill does a stop-order entry actually receive in the top-20 US stocks by opening relative volume, and how large is the gap against the stop price that Zarattini/Barbon/Aziz (SSRN 4729284) credit in their backtest?
why_this_and_not_a_replication: The paper reports Sharpe 2.81 while modelling only a $0.0035/share commission. Machine-checked against its extracted text, the strings 'slippage', 'bid-ask', 'market impact', 'capacity' and 'fill' each occur zero times. Its entry is a stop order, i.e. a market order fired at the instant of maximum momentum in the day's fastest-moving names, and the backtest credits a fill at exactly the stop price. Replicating the eight-year backtest would reproduce that same omission at greater cost. Measuring the omitted quantity decides the result directly.

pinned_artifact.blindness_is_structural: ALPACA_API_KEY_ID / ALPACA_API_SECRET_KEY are unset at pin time, so the harness cannot read market data. Blindness is a property of the environment, not of our discipline.
pinned_artifact.collection_stage_deliberately_absent: The fetch loop is written after the credential exists. It consumes the frozen functions below and cannot alter them without breaking this hash.

scope_limit_stated_before_the_result.therefore: the number produced is a LOWER BOUND on total friction
scope_limit_stated_before_the_result.consequence_for_the_verdict: The classification is asymmetric by construction. A bad result is decisive; a good result is not vindication. The most favourable verdict the harness can emit is NOT_YET_FATAL. There is no verdict named SURVIVES, and a test asserts that no input can produce one.

rule_under_test.source: Zarattini, Barbon & Aziz (2024), Section 2.1 and Section 4
rule_under_test.direction: bullish first 5-minute candle => long only; bearish => short only; doji => no trade
rule_under_test.entry: stop order at the 5-minute high (long) or 5-minute low (short)
rule_under_test.relative_volume_filter: first-5-minute volume >= 100% of its own 14-day average, then the top 20 by that ratio
rule_under_test.R_unit: R = 10% of ATR(14), the paper's stop distance and the unit its PnL is reported in

measurement.trigger: the first TRADE at or through the stop level, at or after 09:35:00 ET, in canonical time order
measurement.fill_priced_from: the QUOTE prevailing at the trigger instant: a buy stop lifts the ask, a sell stop hits the bid
measurement.sign_convention: positive slippage is always ADVERSE; the short case is negated so that a cost can never be reported as a benefit
measurement.why_a_ladder: A retail stop rests at the broker and is routed on trigger, so a fill cannot precede that routing. Zero latency is physically unattainable and is included only because it is the backtest's own implicit assumption; the gap between it and the rest of the ladder is the point.
measurement.units: basis points of R, computed as (slippage_micros * 100000) // atr_micros, integer division
measurement.also_recorded: prevailing spread, resting size at the touched side, and quote age at each rung

decision_rule.anchored_to: the paper's OWN reported per-trade edge, fixed here before any data exists

thresholds_on_median_entry_slippage.meaning: entry slippage alone exceeds even the most favourable per-trade edge the paper reports (0.38R, RelVol > 30x). Stop.
0.15R. Consumes most of any realistic top-20 edge before the exit is even considered.
0.05R. Real, must be carried in any subsequent model, does not by itself refute.
entry friction does not kill it. The exit remains unmeasured, so this is permission to continue, not a finding of profitability.
the median is not worth a verdict at this count

sample.why_this_window: Entirely after the paper's 2016-2023 study period, so the measurement is out of sample with respect to the result it tests.
sample.selection: deterministic weekday sample from the pinned seed, fixed before any data is fetched so the days cannot be chosen after seeing outcomes

fail_closed_commitments: A stock-day whose stop is never touched is NO_TRIGGER, a distinct category. It is NOT a zero-slippage observation and is excluded from the distribution. Undefined is not zero.
A trigger with no prevailing quote is a refusal, not a free fill.
ATR(14) requires 15 daily bars, because 14 bars yield only 13 true ranges. The first bar's true range is undefined, not (high - low).
A percentile of an empty distribution is a refusal, not zero.
An absent price or size field is a refusal, not zero.
A doji returns None, and None is never treated as 'long'.
Every API response is fully paged; a truncated response is a wrong answer, not a small one.

arithmetic_discipline.representation: integer micro-dollars (USD * 1000000) and integer nanosecond timestamps
arithmetic_discipline.only_float_boundary: to_micros() at ingest, applied once per value as it arrives from the API
arithmetic_discipline.percentiles: by integer index, no interpolation; the index rounds DOWN, which for a cost distribution reports the more favourable of the two candidate elements -- stated so the bias is known rather than assumed away
arithmetic_discipline.means_not_reported: sum and count are recorded instead, so a mean is derivable exactly
arithmetic_discipline.timestamps: parsed by hand rather than via datetime.timestamp(), which returns a float and loses the sub-microsecond resolution this measurement is about

defect_found_and_fixed_before_pinning.what: An earlier draft took the ET UTC-offset as a single --tz-offset-hours argument for the whole run.
defect_found_and_fixed_before_pinning.why_it_was_wrong: The 2025 sample spans both DST regimes (23 EDT days, 7 EST). A single offset would have measured a 10:30 or 08:30 'opening range' on the minority regime with nothing in the output to indicate it -- a silent one-hour shift in a quarter of the sample.
defect_found_and_fixed_before_pinning.fix: et_offset_hours() derives the offset per day from the US rule (second Sunday in March to first Sunday in November), refuses pre-2007, and is verified against known 2025 and 2026 boundaries.
defect_found_and_fixed_before_pinning.recorded_because: it was caught by writing the test before freezing, which is the only reason it is not in the pinned artifact

covers: R-unit and basis-point-of-R arithmetic against hand-computed values
adverse-sign convention positive for both long and short
ATR warm-up refusal at 14 bars, success at 15
empty percentile, absent price and absent size all refuse rather than defaulting to zero
doji maps to None and never to a direction
every classify() boundary, on both sides
no input to classify() can produce a verdict of SURVIVES
day sample determinism and weekday-only membership
US DST boundaries for 2025 and 2026, 09:30 ET mapping to 13:30Z in EDT and 14:30Z in EST, and a 5-minute opening range on both sides of the transition

what_would_falsify_the_concern: A median entry slippage below 0.05R across the pinned sample, with the resting size at the touched side large enough to fill a 1%-risk position. That would mean the paper's omission does not change its conclusion, and the next measurement is the exit.
single_use: This preregistration authorises ONE evaluation pass over the pinned sample. Re-running against different days, a different window, or an altered harness is a new document with a new hash.
not_yet_established: Nothing in equities has been measured by this programme. This document describes an experiment that has not been run. See research/B22A_EQUITY_DAYTRADING_PIVOT.md for the external literature it is built on, all of which is someone else's measurement.
